forum.title: STM32H743 ADC3 temperature sensor not reading correctly in latest STMCubeMX 6.18 but was working in earlier STM32CubeMX 6.15
forum.best_answer_content:
They did fix the error on the H723 but in the process ended up breaking it for the more common H743. Points for trying?

[Is there a typo in temperature and VREF Analog conversion macros defined for STM32H723 HAL? | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-embedded-software-32/is-there-a-typo-in-temperature-and-vref-analog-conversion-macros-defined-for-stm32h723-hal-158036)

[Incorrect calculation of \_\_LL\_ADC\_CALC\_VREFANALOG\_VOLTAGE on STM32H723 | Community](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-embedded-software-32/incorrect-calculation-of-ll-adc-calc-vrefanalog-voltage-on-stm32h723-159786)

Macro comments are now incorrect as it scales the value to 12 bits, not 16.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b4a74e83-ede0-46b0-bdfa-e00ae306bd70.png)

Very sloppy. Changing it 100% breaks any code that used it before.

I may be missing something but treating the cal value as 12 bit or 16 bits needs to be processor dependent, and this macro clearly is not written to handle that correctly.
